cands.name: Wendy Hoy
cands.bio: Democratic challenger. Describes experience in education, home health and hospice, assisted living and child advocacy; former assisted-living administrator and Head Start director (directed three centers); guardian ad litem and hotline volunteer, Kiwanian, foster-care charity board member; currently serves on a library board.
cands.local_ties: Calls herself a longtime Florida resident. Campaign mailing address is a PO Box in Oldsmar, FL 34677 (campaign site disclaimer). Where she lives is not stated.

record.text: Candidate questionnaire: says she entered the race after learning the incumbent was unopposed; cites worry that state property tax exemptions reduce revenue for cities, counties and libraries; top issue is rising housing, insurance, utility and health care costs.

cands.gaps: Photo not found (no Wikipedia page; campaign-site image not extracted). Owner-source search returned no relevant hit (unchecked). No endorsements listed on her site or iVoterGuide; no donor or money reporting found.

cands.name: Adam Anderson
cands.bio: Republican businessman and state representative for HD 57 since Nov 2022. Florida State University B.S. in real estate and finance (2005). Managing Partner and CEO of MRA Capital Partners (offices in Tampa, FL and Parsippany, NJ). Chaired the House Health Care Facilities & Systems Subcommittee in 2024-2025.
cands.local_ties: Campaign site says he serves North Pinellas County in the State House; his business is listed with a Tampa office. Home city is not stated in any source seen (Wikipedia, campaign site).

record.text: Sponsored HB 907 (2025), the Sunshine Genetics Pilot Program (newborn genetic testing offered alongside existing screening) and Sunshine Genetics Consortium.
Credited with helping launch the Florida Institute for Pediatric Rare Diseases at the FSU College of Medicine (2024); championed adding Duchenne muscular dystrophy to newborn screening (CS/HB 1089).

cands.gaps: Owner-source search returned no relevant hit (the search tool did not honor the site: filter and no hit mentions him; unchecked). No campaign finance, donor or endorsement reporting found (Florida Politics pages return HTTP 402 to the fetch tool, Ballotpedia returns empty). iVoterGuide (AFA Action) lists no endorsements for him.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
